# Teyfik Gökdemir

> Founder and digital commerce operator building connected commercial systems across strategy, technology, operations and AI-assisted execution.

Teyfik Gökdemir works across digital commerce, e-commerce strategy, growth systems, operational design, sales intelligence and AI-assisted business processes.
